body:
Source: repo-bloat review (rev-tests finding 1 & 2, issue #1043). `packages/coldstart/test/coldstart.test.mjs`, `coldstart-offline.test.mjs`, and `coldstart-cache-e2e.test.mjs` define hand-rolled `makeTempDir`, `makeTmp`, and `cleanTmp` helpers with manual `try/finally` blocks and are allowlisted in `scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs`. With `@adlc/core/test-kit` (`tmp`), fixture directories automatically register cleanup via `t.after` when passed the test context `t`.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In `packages/coldstart/test/coldstart.test.mjs`:
   - Import `{ tmp }` from `@adlc/core/test-kit`.
   - Update test declarations using temp directories to accept `t` parameter.
   - Replace `makeTempDir()` with `tmp(t, 'coldstart-test-')`.
   - Remove manual `try { ... } finally { rmSync(dir, ...); }` blocks, unindenting the test bodies.
   - Delete the local `makeTempDir` helper.
2. In `packages/coldstart/test/coldstart-offline.test.mjs`:
   - Import `{ tmp }` from `@adlc/core/test-kit`.
   - Update test declarations using temp directories to accept `t` parameter.
   - Replace `makeTmp()` with `tmp(t, 'coldstart-offline-')`.
   - Remove manual `try { ... } finally { cleanTmp(dir); }` blocks, unindenting test bodies.
   - Delete local `makeTmp` and `cleanTmp` helpers.
3. In `packages/coldstart/test/coldstart-cache-e2e.test.mjs`:
   - Import `{ tmp }` from `@adlc/core/test-kit`.
   - Update test declarations using temp directories to accept `t` parameter.
   - Replace `makeTmp()` with `tmp(t, 'coldstart-cache-e2e-')`.
   - Remove manual `try { ... } finally { cleanTmp(dir); }` blocks, unindenting test bodies.
   - Delete local `makeTmp` and `cleanTmp` helpers.
4. In `scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs`:
   - Remove `'packages/coldstart/test/coldstart-cache-e2e.test.mjs'`, `'packages/coldstart/test/coldstart-offline.test.mjs'`, and `'packages/coldstart/test/coldstart.test.mjs'` from the `ALLOWLIST` set.
5. Verification:
   - `npm test -w packages/coldstart` exits 0 with all tests passing.
   - `node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs` exits 0.
   - `grep -c 'cleanTmp' packages/coldstart/test/coldstart-offline.test.mjs packages/coldstart/test/coldstart-cache-e2e.test.mjs` is 0 and 0.
   - `grep -c 'makeTempDir' packages/coldstart/test/coldstart.test.mjs` is 0.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 `grep -c 'cleanTmp' packages/coldstart/test/coldstart-offline.test.mjs packages/coldstart/test/coldstart-cache-e2e.test.mjs` is 0 and 0.
- AC2 `grep -c 'makeTempDir' packages/coldstart/test/coldstart.test.mjs` is 0.
- AC3 `grep -E 'packages/coldstart/test/' scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs` returns nothing.
- AC4 `npm test -w packages/coldstart` exits 0 with all tests passing.
- AC5 `node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs` exits 0.
- AC6 `adlc rails-guard` exits 0.
title: refactor(coldstart): adopt @adlc/core/test-kit and eliminate 15 try/finally blocks in coldstart tests
